info.title: rgb-ldk-node HTTP API
info.description: Experimental OpenAPI source of truth for the node HTTP API.

get.description: Returns the aggregated BTC and RGB balances currently tracked by the node. For the freshest wallet/runtime view, callers typically run `POST /wallet/sync` and `POST /rgb/sync` first.

post.description: Claims a held BOLT11 payment using the original payment hash and preimage.
Parses a BOLT11 invoice string and returns a normalized summary.
Fails a held BOLT11 payment identified by payment hash.
Pays a BOLT11 invoice and waits for terminal completion, returning the preimage on success.

408.description: Timed out while waiting for payment completion

post.description: Creates a fixed-amount BOLT11 invoice.
Creates a fixed-amount BOLT11 invoice bound to an explicit payment hash.
Creates a BOLT11 invoice whose amount is chosen by the payer.
Initiates payment for a fixed-amount BOLT11 invoice.
Initiates payment for a BOLT11 invoice using an explicit amount.
Parses a BOLT12 offer and returns a normalized summary.
Creates a fixed-amount BOLT12 offer.
Creates a BOLT12 offer whose amount is chosen by the payer.
Initiates payment to a BOLT12 offer.
Parses a BOLT12 refund and returns a normalized summary.
Creates a BOLT12 refund object and returns the associated payment id.
Builds a BOLT12 invoice from a refund and returns both bech32 and hex forms.
Requests a cooperative close for a channel.
Force-closes a channel when a cooperative close is not desired or possible.
Opens a new Lightning channel, optionally with an RGB allocation.
Adds additional funds from the on-chain wallet into an existing channel without closing it. Pure BTC channels only — RGB asset channels are not yet supported.
Withdraws funds from an existing channel to an on-chain address without closing it. Pure BTC channels only — RGB asset channels are not yet supported.

get.description: Returns the current Lightning channels with extended BTC and RGB balance details.

post.description: Marks the most recently delivered event as handled so processing can continue.
Blocks until the next node event becomes available and returns it as a DTO.

get.description: Returns a basic liveness probe for the HTTP server itself.
Returns the list of socket addresses currently advertised by the node.

get.summary: Get info for a channel by short channel ID
List all short channel IDs in the network graph
Get info for a node by hex node_id
List all node IDs in the network graph

get.description: Returns the node's public key in hex format.

post.summary: Compute blinded paths for an async recipient (experimental)
post.description: Returns BlindedMessagePaths for an async recipient identified by `recipient_id_hex`. Requires the node to be running in async-payments Server role.

503.description: Node is not in async-payments Server role

post.description: Returns a BOLT-12 offer that a static invoice server can serve invoices for on this node's behalf when offline. Available on any node; the offer is only produced after `set_static_invoice_server_paths` has been called and the static-invoice handshake completes.

post.summary: Configure paths to a static-invoice server (experimental)
post.description: Sets the BlindedMessagePaths used to interactively build offers with a static-invoice server. `paths_hex` is the Writeable serialization of `Vec<BlindedMessagePath>`, hex-encoded. Available on any node.

get.description: Returns the current state and details of a single payment by id.

post.description: Stops tracking a payment locally.
Waits until the payment reaches a terminal state or the timeout elapses.

408.description: Timed out while waiting for the payment

get.description: Returns all known payments tracked by the node.
Returns the known peers together with connection and persistence state.

post.description: Connects to a peer and optionally persists it in the peer store.
Disconnects a currently known peer.

get.description: Returns readiness details for the node runtime and P2P listener.

503.description: Node runtime is not ready yet

get.description: Returns a previously stored consignment by key. This is the follow-up download endpoint for `consignment_key` values returned by RGB export/send operations. The response body is binary and can be encoded as raw, gzip, or zip.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: raw, gzip, or zip

get.description: Returns the aggregated L1 balance view for a single RGB contract. For the freshest view after transfers or confirmations, call `POST /rgb/sync` first.
Returns whether the node currently knows a given RGB contract id. This is a lightweight public probe endpoint useful before attempting imports, transfers, or UI contract lookups.
Returns RGB contracts currently known to the local RGB runtime/stockpile together with best-effort metadata. This is the catalog view to inspect after imports, issuance, or runtime sync.

post.description: Exports a contract consignment for transfer or archival. By default it returns JSON containing a stored `consignment_key`; when `download=true` it streams the encoded bytes directly so they can be forwarded or saved immediately.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: When true, return the consignment bytes directly

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Binary download format: raw, gzip, or zip

post.description: Imports a contract consignment from the raw request body. Use this with bytes produced by `/rgb/contracts/export?download=true` or `/rgb/consignments/{consignment_key}`. The body may be raw, gzip, or zip depending on the `format` query parameter.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Upload format: auto, raw, gzip, or zip

post.description: Issues a new RGB contract using an imported issuer plus an RGB-wallet UTXO. Typical flow: `POST /rgb/issuers/import` -> fund the RGB wallet -> `POST /rgb/sync` -> `POST /rgb/contracts/issue`. If `utxo` is omitted, the node auto-selects a suitable RGB-wallet outpoint.

get.description: Returns the public RGB wallet root descriptor plus derived public descriptors used by address/signing workflows. This is primarily for audits, interoperability, or descriptor inspection; it does not spend funds or change wallet state.

Lists issuer files currently present in the local issuer registry. These names are used by `POST /rgb/contracts/issue`. Corrupt or unloadable issuer files are returned separately in `invalid_issuers` so callers can surface cleanup actions.

post.description: Imports an issuer archive into the local issuer registry. Typical flow before contract issuance: `POST /rgb/issuers/import` -> `POST /rgb/contracts/issue`. The raw request body may be a raw `.issuer` file or a gzip/zip archive carrying one issuer entry, selected via the `format` query parameter.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Upload format: auto, raw, gzip, or zip

post.description: Creates an RGB-aware Lightning invoice using a contract id, asset amount, and BTC carrier amount. The invoice embeds both the RGB asset data and the BTC carrier value required to keep the RGB state spendable on Lightning.
Creates an RGB-aware hold invoice bound to an explicit payment hash. Use this when the caller must control the payment hash while still embedding RGB asset data and the BTC carrier amount.

Decodes an RGB-aware Lightning invoice and returns both BTC carrier fields and embedded RGB asset fields. Use this before `POST /rgb/ln/pay` when the caller needs to know whether the invoice already carries RGB metadata or whether explicit contract/asset fields must be supplied.

Pays an RGB Lightning invoice. When the invoice already embeds RGB fields, the request can contain just the invoice. When it does not, callers must also supply `contract_id` and `asset_amount`. The BTC carrier amount inside the invoice must still satisfy the RGB minimum carrier requirement.

Generates a new address owned by the dedicated RGB wallet descriptor. Use this for `/rgb/utxos/fund`, `/rgb/utxos/top_up`, RGB invoice beneficiaries, and other outputs that should later appear in `/rgb/utxos` after `POST /rgb/sync`. Do not use it for ordinary BTC change; use `POST /wallet/new_address` for that.

Creates an RGB on-chain invoice using either witness-out or blinded beneficiary mode. Set `use_witness_utxo=true` when you want an explicit witness-output beneficiary in the invoice. Set `use_witness_utxo=false` for blinded invoices; if `blinding_utxo` is omitted in that mode, the node auto-selects an available RGB-wallet outpoint, so callers should usually run `POST /rgb/sync` first.

Parses an RGB on-chain invoice and returns beneficiary, amount, and expiry details. Use this before send/receive flows when a caller needs to inspect whether the invoice uses witness-out or blinded beneficiary mode.

get.description: Returns RGB on-chain payment history, optionally filtered by contract id. This is the lifecycle log for invoices, sends, receives, and associated consignment keys/download paths.

post.description: Accepts an RGB on-chain consignment into the local wallet. JSON mode is best when the caller already has a `consignment_key` plus either `invoice` or `payment_id`. Binary mode is for raw/gzip/zip consignment uploads and requires `payment_id` in the query string so the node can map the upload to an existing payment record. When the invoice was created elsewhere, prefer JSON mode and pass the full invoice string.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Binary upload format: auto, raw, gzip, or zip

parameters.name: payment_id
parameters.description: Required for binary uploads; omitted for JSON requests unless needed

post.description: Builds and broadcasts an RGB on-chain payment transaction for an invoice. Use this for contract-bearing RGB transfers, not for empty RGB-UTXO lifecycle management (`/rgb/utxos/fund`, `/rgb/utxos/top_up`, `/rgb/utxos/sweep`). The response returns a `consignment_key`; receivers or follow-up tooling typically need that consignment to complete the transfer.

post.summary: Sign message with RGB wallet key
post.description: Signs an arbitrary message using the RGB wallet descriptor key. `bitcoin_signed_message` uses the request `message` string directly. `ecdsa` interprets the request `message` as bytes encoded with the requested `encoding`, then signs the SHA-256 digest of those bytes. The response `signature` uses the same `encoding`.

Synchronizes the RGB runtime/stockpile with the configured chain data and then refreshes the node's ordinary wallet view without triggering a second RGB refresh. Call this after funding the RGB wallet, importing or issuing contracts, broadcasting RGB on-chain operations, or when confirmations change and you want `/rgb/utxos`, `/rgb/contracts`, and RGB balances to reflect the latest state.

get.description: Returns the canonical RGB spend-domain outpoint view, including RGB allocations, semantic spend roles, and txoscope-backed lock metadata. Newly created or newly confirmed RGB outputs usually require `POST /rgb/sync` before they appear here. By default this uses a fast cached view; pass `refresh=true` to reconcile txoscope state and refresh confirmation heights for already-known RGB outpoints.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: When true, reconcile txoscope state and refresh chain confirmation heights before returning

post.description: Low-level, stateless primitive that converts exact ordinary BTC-wallet inputs into one or more empty RGB-wallet outputs. Typical flow: `POST /wallet/sync` -> `GET /wallet/utxos` (pick exact inputs) -> `POST /rgb/new_address` (one per RGB output) -> `POST /wallet/new_address` (change) -> `POST /rgb/utxos/fund` -> `POST /rgb/sync`. The handler does not auto-select inputs or change outputs.
Clears a manual reservation previously created by `POST /rgb/utxos/reserve`. Prefer releasing by `reservation_id`; `outpoint` is a convenience fallback when the id is unavailable.

Temporarily marks an RGB-wallet outpoint unavailable for other flows. Use this around multi-step caller-driven sequences when you first select an outpoint from `GET /rgb/utxos` and need it to stay stable until a later operation. If `outpoint` is omitted, the node auto-selects one available RGB-wallet UTXO.

get.description: Deprecated compatibility projection. Use `GET /rgb/utxos` for the canonical RGB UTXO view with allocations, spend roles, and lock metadata. By default this uses a fast cached view; pass `refresh=true` to reconcile txoscope state and refresh confirmation heights for already-known RGB outpoints.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: When true, reconcile txoscope state and refresh chain confirmation heights before returning

post.description: Low-level primitive that spends one empty, confirmed, unlocked RGB-wallet output back to an ordinary BTC-wallet address. Use this only for RGB outpoints with no allocations; otherwise use normal RGB payment flows or `/rgb/utxos/top_up`. Typical flow: `POST /rgb/sync` -> `GET /rgb/utxos` -> `POST /wallet/new_address` -> `POST /rgb/utxos/sweep`.

Low-level primitive that replaces one confirmed, unlocked RGB UTXO with a larger RGB-wallet output while preserving its anchored single-contract RGB state. Typical flow: `POST /rgb/sync` -> `GET /rgb/utxos` (pick the RGB input) -> `POST /wallet/sync` + `GET /wallet/utxos` (pick extra BTC inputs) -> `POST /rgb/new_address` (replacement output) -> `POST /wallet/new_address` (change) -> `POST /rgb/utxos/top_up`. The response includes a `consignment_key` for the replacement transfer.
Sends a keysend payment, optionally with custom TLV records.

get.description: Returns the current runtime, listener, and best-block status of the node.
Returns HTTP API versioning metadata for compatibility checks.

post.description: Generates a new receive/change address from the ordinary BTC wallet account. Use this for plain BTC funding, explicit change on RGB UTXO-management calls, and outputs that should later appear in `/wallet/utxos`. Do not use it for RGB-owned outputs; use `POST /rgb/new_address` for those.

Synchronizes the ordinary BTC wallet with the configured chain source and persists newly observed wallet outputs. Call this before selecting inputs from `GET /wallet/utxos`, or before expecting fresh receive/change outputs to appear in the ordinary wallet view.

get.description: Returns only ordinary BTC-account outpoints according to txoscope classification, together with txoscope-backed lock metadata. Newly discovered wallet outputs appear here only after `POST /wallet/sync`. Pass `refresh=true` to reconcile txoscope state and refresh confirmation heights for already-known outputs; it does not discover new wallet outputs on its own.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: When true, reconcile txoscope state and refresh chain confirmation heights before returning

recipient_id_hex.description: Hex-encoded recipient identifier; opaque bytes chosen by the caller.

AsyncReceiveOfferResponse.description:
Response of `/payment/bolt12/async/receive_offer`.

**Experimental**: BOLT-12 async payments support is experimental.

offer.description: The async-payment offer as a `lno1...` string.

AsyncSetStaticInvoiceServerPathsRequest.description:
Request body for `/payment/bolt12/async/set_static_invoice_server_paths`.

`paths_hex` is the hex-encoded `Writeable` serialization of `Vec<BlindedMessagePath>`,
matching the wire format used by the UniFFI bindings.

BalancesDto.description: Wallet and channel balance overview (BTC + RGB).

Bolt11ClaimForHashRequest.description:
Manually claim a held payment created via `/bolt11/receive_for_hash`.

Requires the original preimage that corresponds to the payment hash.

Bolt11FailForHashRequest.description: Request to fail a held payment by its payment hash.

Bolt11PayRequest.description: Preferred BOLT11 payment endpoint: waits for completion and returns preimage.

Bolt11PayResponse.description: Response of a completed BOLT11 payment.

Bolt11ReceiveForHashRequest.description:
Request to create a BOLT11 invoice for a specific payment hash (hold invoice).

The resulting invoice will NOT be auto-claimed. The receiver must manually
call `/bolt11/claim_for_hash` or `/bolt11/fail_for_hash` after receiving
the `PaymentClaimable` event.

Bolt11ReceiveRequest.description: Request to create a BOLT11 invoice.

Bolt11ReceiveResponse.description: Response containing a newly created BOLT11 invoice.

Bolt11ReceiveVarRequest.description: Request to create a variable-amount BOLT11 invoice.

Bolt11SendRequest.description: Request to pay a BOLT11 invoice.

Bolt11SendUsingAmountRequest.description: Request to pay a BOLT11 invoice using a specified amount.

expiry_secs.description: Seconds from now; if omitted, offer does not expire.
Seconds from now; if omitted, offer does not expire.

amount_msat.description: Required for zero-amount offers; may be used to overpay fixed-amount offers.

anchor_channels_reserve_sats.description: Sum of sats reserved for anchor channels.

lightning_total_sats.description: Total claimable Lightning balance in satoshis.

onchain_total_sats.description: Total confirmed on-chain balance in satoshis.

ChannelDetailsExtendedDto.description: Channel details entry (extended for control-plane integrations).

channel_point.description: Funding outpoint formatted as `txid:vout` if known.

local_balance_msat.description:
Estimated local (our) total balance in millisatoshis.

This includes our `unspendable_punishment_reserve` and therefore may be higher than
`outbound_capacity_msat`.

Returns `None` for outbound channels until the counterparty accepts the channel (as LDK
will report `unspendable_punishment_reserve = None`).

local_unspendable_punishment_reserve_sat.description: Local (our) unspendable punishment reserve in satoshis.

remote_balance_msat.description:
Estimated remote (counterparty) total balance in millisatoshis.

This is derived as `channel_value_sats * 1000 - local_balance_msat` and is therefore also
`None` if `local_balance_msat` is unavailable.

remote_unspendable_punishment_reserve_sa.description: Remote (counterparty) unspendable punishment reserve in satoshis.

oneOf.description: RGB asset balance in this channel, if any.

CloseChannelRequest.description: Request to close or force-close a channel.

EventDto.description: Event DTO (subset; others are mapped to `Other`).

ListeningAddressesResponse.description: Response containing the node's listening addresses.

NetworkGraphChannelInfoResponse.description:
Information about a channel (both directions), as observed via channel_announcement and
channel_update gossip messages.

NetworkGraphChannelsResponse.description: List of short channel IDs currently known in the network graph.

NetworkGraphNodeInfoResponse.description:
Information about a node, derived from channel announcements and (optionally) a node

NodeAnnouncementInfoDto.description: Information from a node's most recent node_announcement.

NodeIdResponse.description: Response containing the node's public key.

OpenChannelRequest.description: Request to open a channel to a peer.

OpenChannelResponse.description: Response of a successful channel open request.

Payment kind-specific details (machine-friendly).

status.description: Status, one of Pending, Succeeded, Failed.

remote_amount.description: Remote (counterparty) RGB balance in this channel.

BTC carrier amount in msat embedded into the BOLT11 invoice.

btc_carrier_amount_msat.description:
BTC carrier amount in msat embedded into the BOLT11 invoice.

This must stay above the RGB dust/carrier minimum or invoice creation will fail.

expiry_secs.description: Invoice expiry in seconds. If omitted, the BOLT11 default expiry is used.

asset_amount.description: RGB asset amount embedded in the invoice, if present.

carrier_amount_msat.description: BTC carrier amount, if the invoice specifies one.

contract_id.description: RGB contract id embedded in the invoice, if present.

destination.description: Payee node id recovered from the invoice signature.

payment_hash.description: Payment hash embedded in the invoice.

asset_amount.description: Optional explicit asset amount for invoices that do not embed RGB fields.

contract_id.description: Optional explicit contract ID for invoices that do not embed RGB fields.

address.description:
Address owned by the dedicated RGB wallet descriptor.

Use this for RGB wallet outputs created via `/rgb/utxos/fund`, `/rgb/utxos/top_up`, or as
RGB invoice beneficiaries. Outputs sent here appear in `/rgb/utxos` after `/rgb/sync`, not
in `/wallet/utxos`.

blinding_utxo.description:
Outpoint used for blinding when `use_witness_utxo=false`.

If omitted and `use_witness_utxo=false`, the node will auto-select a wallet UTXO.

expiry_secs.description:
Expiration time for the invoice in seconds.

If omitted, the server will apply a reasonable default.

use_witness_utxo.description:
Controls whether the invoice uses a witness-output (`wout:`) beneficiary (`true`) or a
blinded auth-token (`at:`) beneficiary (`false`).

This field is intentionally required at the API level to avoid ambiguous requests where
callers accidentally rely on defaults and create an invoice type they didn't intend.

invoice.description: Serialized RGB on-chain invoice string to parse.

amount.description: RGB amount embedded in the invoice.

contract_id.description: Contract id embedded in the invoice.

use_witness_utxo.description: Whether the beneficiary is witness-output based.

blinding_utxo_used.description: Outpoint actually used for blinding when creating a blinded invoice (`use_witness_utxo=false`).

status.description: One of: pending | succeeded | failed | expired

consignment_key.description: Stored consignment key previously returned by an RGB send/export endpoint.

invoice.description:
Optional invoice string this consignment is expected to satisfy.

Callers must provide either `payment_id` or `invoice` so the node can correlate the
consignment to a single stable payment record.

payment_id.description:
Optional invoice id (hex-encoded 32 bytes, i.e. `sha256(invoice_str)`).

Callers must provide either `payment_id` or `invoice` so the node can correlate the
consignment to a single stable payment record.

contract_id.description: Contract id accepted from the consignment.

sats_for_fee_and_outputs.description: Optional explicit BTC amount to provide for fee payment and carrier outputs.

asset_amount.description: RGB asset amount to commit into the channel.

color_context_data.description: RGB color context data (e.g. a consignment endpoint like `file://...`).

is_swap.description: Whether this payment is part of an atomic swap.

compact.description: When `algorithm=ecdsa`, request a compact ECDSA signature if supported.

SendResponse.description: Response containing the id of a sent payment.

SpliceInRequest.description:
Request to splice additional on-chain funds into an existing channel (splice-in).

**Experimental**: this API mirrors `Node::splice_in` and the underlying
behavior may change in future releases. Currently only supported on pure
BTC channels — RGB asset channels are not yet covered.

SpliceOutRequest.description:
Request to splice funds out of an existing channel to an on-chain address (splice-out).

**Experimental**: see [`SpliceInRequest`].

SpontaneousSendRequest.description: Request to send a spontaneous (keysend) payment.

best_block_height.description: Current best block height as seen by the node.

is_listening.description: Whether the node is currently listening for inbound peers.

is_running.description: Whether the node runtime is running.

WalletNewAddressResponse.description: Response containing a newly-generated on-chain address.

address.description:
Receive/change address from the ordinary BTC wallet account.

Use this for plain BTC funding, `/wallet/utxos` change outputs, and the explicit
`change_address` field on RGB UTXO-management endpoints. Do not use it for RGB-owned
outputs; use `/rgb/new_address` for those.

WalletUtxoDto.description: Ordinary L1 wallet UTXO with confirmation and lock metadata.

confirmation.description: Confirmation status from the node's wallet/chain view.

lock.description: txoscope lock state for this ordinary BTC-wallet outpoint.

value_sats.description: BTC value of the output in sats.

expires_at_unix_secs.description: Lock expiry in unix seconds, if txoscope exposes one.

locked.description: Whether this outpoint is currently unavailable for new flows.

operation_id.description: Reservation or selected operation id, if locked.

WalletUtxosResponse.description: Response containing the ordinary L1 wallet UTXO view.

utxos.description:
Ordinary BTC-account outpoints known to txoscope.

RGB wallet outputs are intentionally excluded from this view.
